notes: High-level: Treasury/Payments FS firm exploring private VPC deployment for regulatory chat/search workloads.
Primary ask: BYOK/HSM integration so all master keys live in customer account; Redwood should never have access to unwrapped keys.
Preferred cloud: AWS first (must support AWS KMS CMKs + CloudHSM-backed keys); Azure Key Vault and GCP KMS are required for multi-region customers.
Key requirements: HSM-backed CMKs, support key rotation without downtime, ability to rotate regularly (90d policy), ability to revoke access and rotate during incident.
Audit & logging: Must stream KMS operations and service audit logs to their Splunk/SIEM; require signed audit events and retention for 7 years for compliance team.
Data residency: Sensitive PII processed in us-east-1 and eu-west-1 only; need clear mapping of which model endpoints and inference pods live where.
Control plane: Want private control plane option (no public internet); if control plane is hosted, it must tunnel over customer-managed VPC/VPN with egress restrictions.
Security review status: Completed initial questionnaire (sent 11/21), infrastructure diagram requested (next step), penetration test required pre-prod.
Technical constraints: No plaintext key material in Redwood account; must use KMS API grants or envelope encryption with customer CMK in their account.
Integration approaches discussed on call:
- Envelope encryption: Redwood manages data keys encrypted with customer CMK; Redwood never stores plaintext master keys.
- KMS grants model: Use temporary grants from customer's AWS KMS to Redwood service role, with explicit scope and expiration.
- CloudHSM-backed CMKs: For FIPS/HSM guarantees, use CloudHSM cluster owned by customer and AWS KMS integrated with it.
Azure/GCP notes: Azure Key Vault + Azure Dedicated HSM discussed for EU-region customers; GCP KMS + external HSM (CloudHSM equivalent) for GCP-first teams.

POC scope: 6-week POC. Week 1-2: connectivity + VPC peering & private control plane proof. Week 3: KMS integration (create CMK in customer account, test envelope flows). Week 4: rotation & revoke tests. Week 5-6: load + failover and audit log forwarding validation.
Performance SLA: Want confirmation that KMS round-trips add <5% median token latency; can accept small overhead if documented with load tests.
Compliance asks: SOC2 Type II + evidence of key handling controls; ISO27001 preferred. They will request architecture diagram for audit team.
Quotes/voice notes: 'We cannot permit any vendor-managed master keys for production' — Head of Infra.
Procurement timeline: Security + legal sign-off drives schedule; procurement team aiming for decision by 2026-06 if POC meets controls.
Open technical questions for Redwood:
- Can we support customer-owned CloudHSM clusters for HSM-backed CMKs in all target regions?
- How does Redwood handle KMS key rotation during active sessions (KV cache, in-flight tokens)?
- What exact audit log fields will be emitted and how long are they retained by default?
- Are there any additional latencies when routing to a region-specific model variant vs. fallback?
Security artifacts requested: infra diagram, KMS/BYOK runbook, audit-log schema, encryption whitepaper, penetration test policy.
Meeting notes: 11/21 discovery call with Head of Infra, SecOps, and Procurement. Luis demoed private control plane slide and BYOK options.
Action items assigned:
- Anika: provide BYOK runbook and template contractual language for key custody (due 11/26).
- Luis: prototype envelope encryption flow with sample CMK in staging (due 12/03).
- Security: prepare audit log schema and Splunk ingestion example (due 12/01).
Engagement risks: legal wants explicit indemnity language around key compromise; procurement asks for fixed pricing for Dedicated capacity if committed.
Decision criteria: Must pass SecOps checklist + perf test under 90th pct latency budget + contractual BYOK guarantees.
If POC passes, expected first-year ARR split: private deployment fee + monthly reserved capacity + ops support add-on.
Notes tone: concise, fragment-style CRM notes; further details in linked drive doc and fireflies transcript.
